lines.t: Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh.
Under the heavy storm the nations bend,
Walls' broken blood fills the street again,
Lamentations rise in the midnight air Old enemies gather, weighed down by despair
From Gaza's border to Jerusalem's gate Hands lifting, bleeding hearts search for faith
And what peace is written on trembling skin
When sorrow breathes where rebellion's been
Oh, watchmen upon the walls
Sound your cry once more
The Lamb's blood calls through shattered doors
Not by sword, no man's fragile accord
But by the breath and word of the sovereign Lord
Peace will not come by treaty or hand
But by the fire and cleansing across this land
Silent tears stain the ancient stone
Mothers wail for children gone
The prophets' voices ring, the trumpets blast
Judgment thunders as shadows are cast
The King who wept for Zion's night
Returns with justice, glory, and life
From east to west, from grave to sea
The harvest comes for those who heed
Repent, you nations, lift your face
Shake off the dust, receive His grace
The cup must pass the reckoning year
Yet mercy lingers for all who fear
Oh, watchmen upon the walls
Sound your cry once more
The Lamb's blood calls through shattered doors
Not by sword, nor man's fragile eye of corn
But by the breath and word of the sovereign Lord
True peace breaks at Messiah's feet
In rivers of living water, judgment and mercy
I see you
So let the walls echo with hope and warning
He is coming soon for evening and morning
Glory to the King, the Lion, and the Lamb
All nations bow to the great I Am
